pages.text: All language blocks are as high as a slab. You place them on the floor between x=5 and x=28. The first block of a line is the $(l)keyword block$(). It decides what the line does.

Some mistakes are stopped right away. If a block may not go somewhere, it is not placed and you get a message with the reason.$(br2)Some blocks need more information. Right-click a LABEL, LITERAL, OPERATOR, COMMENT or TAG block with an $(l)empty hand$() to open its dialog. Click the green check mark to save.
A $(l)LABEL$() holds a name, like the name of a function. A $(l)LITERAL$() holds a value, like 42 or "Hello". An $(l)OPERATOR$() holds a symbol, like + or the $(1);$() that ends a calculation.
